paragraphs: Doobert is an online software platform custom-built for animal rescuers. Chris and Rachael Roy are named as its founders and owners.

The software is built to help animal welfare organizations streamline foster management, engage volunteers and better care for animals. It grew out of transporting shelter dogs from high-kill locations to areas where they were more likely to be adopted. Developers were hired to put together a system to coordinate those trips. The company calls Doobert the only foster home management solution out there.

Since its launch in May 2014, the company says Doobert has grown to support over 35,000 volunteers and 5,000 organizations across the United States and Canada. Its members are called Dooberteers, who the site says make a difference in the lives of animals every day.
